text:
Ari (Growth): quick experiment idea for next webinar launch posts — combine urgency copy with tiny timeboxed credits + 3 prompt starter packs. primary KPI: +22% reg -> first_api_call in 7 days. :rocket:

Dana (Content): ok what are the arms? keep copy super short for social + 3 post-reg email variants.

Ari (Growth): draft matrix:
- Control: baseline prompt pack, 0 credits
- Urgency (30%): 72-hour sprint credits (60) + quickstart pack
- Always (20%): persistent credits (60) + vertical prompt pack
Randomize at RSVP completion. We'll A/B two launch narratives (benchmark vs quickstarter) on socials.

Luc (Analytics): measurement: 7d window. events: `webinar_rsvp`,`post_reg_email_sent`,`prompt_pack_assigned`,`credit_redeemed`,`first_api_call`,`demo_click`. add `exp_arm` to payloads and UTMs. I'll add a dashboard tile and baseline comparison to last 3 webinars.

Nora (Ops): routing rule question: fast-route SDR ping if `credit_redeemed` OR `demo_click` within first 48h? or only demo click?

Ari (Growth): nested routing test: half of each arm gets standard nurture, half gets fast-route on credit or demo click. measure interaction. Also enforce dedupe: if user appears multiple times, keep highest credit assignment.

Dana (Content): copy snippets (short):
- Benchmark social: "See how teams cut inference cost — join our webinar + try 60 credits."
- Quickstarter social: "Ship a search assistant in 30m — register + grab starter prompts."
Post-reg emails (one-liners):
- Control: "You're in — open your prompts"
- Urgency: "72h: 60 credits inside — claim now"
- Always: "60 credits + vertical prompts inside"
I'll post HTML snippets and the 3 starter packs in #marketing-assets by EOD.

Luc (Analytics): add UTMs: `utm_campaign=webinar_quickstart_v3` and `utm_experiment={arm}`. pseudocode for tile: 
```
SELECT exp_arm, routing_flow, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) as regs, SUM(CASE WHEN first_api_call THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as activations FROM events WHERE time BETWEEN $start AND $end GROUP BY exp_arm, routing_flow;
```
I'll compute conversion lift vs baseline and cost-per-activation assuming full redemption of credits.

hubspot-bot: queued HubSpot props: `exp_arm`,`routing_flow`,`credit_tier`,`dedupe_flag`. Mapping ETA: tomorrow noon.

experiment-bot: experiment created: `exp_2165432100_quickstart_urgency_routing` — arms: control/urgency/always; routing nested: standard/fast-route. Dry-run Mon 09:00 PT.

Nora (Ops): I'll implement dedupe logic and the SDR ping template: "Webinar reg — redeemed: <tier> — demo click: <yes/no>". Also will surface duplicates to ops dashboard.

Ari (Growth): timeline: tracking signoff Fri, creative Wed, dry-run Mon, full launch Thu. Sync Fri 10am. Keep RSVP -> redeem as low friction as possible. Flag any edge cases here. :pray:
